entities.name: N-SEM deprotection
observations: The reactant contains a lactam ring nitrogen protected as N-CH2-CH2-O-Si(CH3)3; the product contains the corresponding lactam NH while the core scaffold remains unchanged.
The transformation is acid-promoted cleavage of a 2-(trimethylsilyl)ethoxymethyl (SEM) protecting group.

entities.name: Hydrogen chloride
observations: Most likely deprotection reagent; used as HCl in 1,4-dioxane in the matched precedent.

entities.name: HCl in 1,4-dioxane, 23 C, 18 h
observations: Closest exact precedent used chloride with 1,4-dioxane, corresponding to HCl in dioxane, at 23 °C for 18 hours and gave 80% yield.

entities.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
observations: Plausible alternative strong protic acid for SEM deprotection, but not directly supported by the matched record.
